input.prompt: A project followed the pinned bug-fix workflow, but a later regression proved the workflow omitted a required concurrency check. We have a durable regression evidence file. What should happen?
A developer typo broke one project function. The Framework debugging and verification procedures worked correctly and exposed the typo. Should this automatically become Framework feedback?
I feel the Framework workflow is inefficient but I have no durable evidence, repeated case, or measured impact. Capture it as an evidence-backed Framework gap now.
The project used Framework commit abc123 while Framework main moved later. Which Framework version belongs in the feedback event?
The feedback is high confidence and suggests changing a Framework workflow. Apply the change to Framework Core automatically from the project task.
